title: HackFest 2024 — 24hr Mega Hackathon
description: Join us for the biggest hackathon of the year! 24 hours, unlimited pizza, and a chance to win ₹50,000 in prizes. Build innovative solutions around the theme 'Tech for Good'. Teams of 2-4. All branches welcome!

title: Weekly Coding Contest #42
description: Our weekly competitive programming contest on Codeforces. 5 problems, 2 hours. Ratings will be updated. Solve problems from Easy to Expert level.

title: ML Workshop: Build Your First Neural Network
description: Hands-on workshop for beginners to build and train a neural network from scratch using TensorFlow and Keras. Bring your laptops! Prerequisites: Basic Python knowledge.

title: AI Paper Reading: Attention Is All You Need
description: Join us as we deep-dive into the seminal Transformer paper. We'll discuss the architecture, its implications, and how it shaped modern LLMs. Open to all students!

title: Tarang 2024 — Annual Cultural Fest
description: The grand annual cultural extravaganza! Three days of music, dance, drama, and art. Star performer night, competitions, workshops, and food stalls. Free entry for all students!

title: Inter-College Cricket Tournament 2024
description: Annual inter-college cricket tournament with 16 teams competing. T20 format. Prize money and trophies for the top 3 teams. Register your team of 15 players.

title: CTF Championship: Capture The Flag 2024
description: Test your cybersecurity skills! Categories include Web Exploitation, Cryptography, Reverse Engineering, and Forensics. Individual participation. 24-hour online event.

title: Eco-Hackathon: Sustainable Solutions
description: Build tech solutions for real environmental problems faced by our campus and city. Categories: Waste Management, Energy Efficiency, Water Conservation, and Biodiversity.
